patterns.title: Separate Observation from Interpretation
patterns.summary: Describe the specific event separately from the meaning you attach to it, so the conversation has a workable starting point.

patterns.title: Distinguish Feelings from Conclusions
patterns.summary: Name your emotional experience separately from claims about another person’s intentions or behavior.

patterns.title: Separate Needs from Strategies
patterns.summary: Identify what matters beneath a preferred solution, then explore other ways to address it while preserving real obligations.

patterns.title: Make the Request Concrete
patterns.summary: Turn a broad wish into a specific, observable action that someone can understand and answer.

patterns.title: Leave Room for No
patterns.summary: Make requests whose answers can influence the conversation, while preserving your needs, boundaries, and responsibilities.

patterns.title: Understand Before Solving
patterns.summary: Find out what someone is experiencing and what kind of help they want before offering solutions.

patterns.title: Give Yourself Empathy First
patterns.summary: Acknowledge your own feelings and concerns before choosing how to respond, without excusing harmful conduct.

patterns.title: Make Appreciation Specific
patterns.summary: Describe a particular contribution and what it meant to you, without turning gratitude into pressure or debt.
